key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters control the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: Tuning nozzle travel speed and spray distance can help engineers target coating geometry and maximize water repellency.
method: Characterize coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships linking spray distance to roughness and contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical process window or validation metrics, so the equations require verification before transfer to other spraying setups.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
